[The wider network]{.eyebrow}

## A growing community

Beyond the core team, MoDD Africa connects modellers, researchers and decision-makers through a regional Community of Practice in vector epidemiology and modelling, and works directly with National Malaria Programmes across the three countries. New team members and hub leads will be added here as the network formalises.
